items.title: Self-Play Meets Skill Evolution: Self-Evolving Search Agents that Pose, Solve, and Remember
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2607.29468v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Self-play agents can generate training problems without questions from target benchmarks, but their curricula lack persistent state: failures affect gradients yet do not explicitly shape future practice. External skill memories preserve procedural experience but are typically learned from fixed task distributions. We introduce \textbf{SESA} (Self-Evolving Skill-Augmented Agent), which makes procedural memory an evolving state of tool-augmented search self-play. A challenger poses problems, while a separately parameterized solver alone retrieves skills. Informative failures are distilled into reusable skills and written back to memory. The updated memory changes solver behavior and success, which changes the challenger's reward and the distribution of future problems; the resulting frontier produces new failures that rewrite memory. items.title: Fragility of Value under Imperfect Alignment
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2607.28881v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: As more responsibility is placed upon AI systems, it becomes increasingly important to guarantee that these systems are aligned with humanity. A common fear in AI safety is that human value is fragile -- that is, optimizing too heavily for an imperfect proxy to human values will lead to a catastrophic outcome. In this paper, we present a model of the alignment problem where an agent undergoes idealized alignment training that guarantees its value function satisfies a proxy condition before optimizing the world. Our primary results identify conditions on the human value function and the accuracy of several proxy conditions under which an agent with an $\eta$-catastrophic value function, one that is guaranteed to take the expectation of human value below $\eta$ in the limit of optimizing power, would be deployed. items.reason_zh: 探讨AI对齐中价值脆弱性的理论模型，对AI安全有深远影响，值得深入阅读。
items.summary_zh: 本文提出一个模型，研究在AI对齐过程中，当优化目标不完美时，人类价值可能变得脆弱，导致灾难性后果。作者通过形式化分析，展示了价值脆弱性的条件，并讨论了如何通过设计更稳健的对齐方法来缓解这一风险。该研究为AI安全领域提供了新的理论视角，强调了在追求对齐时需谨慎处理代理目标与真实价值之间的偏差。

items.title: Safety, or Just Capability? A Validity Audit of Agent-Safety Benchmarks
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2607.28685v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Agent-safety benchmarks measure different behaviors, and their scores get quoted interchangeably as an agent's safety. We treat four of them (R-Judge, InjecAgent, AgentHarm, AgentDojo) as measurements to be validated, running each under its official implementation and author-provided scorer on up to 22 models, with MMLU and GPQA measured by us under one protocol as a capability composite. items.reason_zh: 对四个智能体安全基准进行效度审计，揭示其测量差异，对安全评估有重要参考。
items.summary_zh: 本文对四个智能体安全基准（R-Judge、InjecAgent、AgentHarm、AgentDojo）进行效度审计。这些基准测量不同行为，但分数常被互换引用为智能体的安全性。作者在官方实现和作者提供的评分器下，对多达22个模型运行每个基准，并测量MMLU和GPQA。结果显示这些基准测量不同维度，分数不可互换。文章强调需要更严谨的安全评估方法，避免误导性结论。
items.title_zh: 安全还是仅能力？智能体安全基准的效度审计

items.title: On the Generalization of Steering Vectors for Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2607.29062v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Model capabilities have improved in large part due to scaling chain of thought. This has been a promising development for AI safety--where models verbalize their reasoning, it is possible to monitor it. However, in some cases, models do not verbalize important steps in their reasoning process. For example, models prompted with a cue suggesting the incorrect answer may fail to acknowledge that cue, even when it appears instrumental to their conclusion. When chain of thought (CoT) fails to disclose instrumental reasoning steps, we describe it as unfaithful. Prior work has shown that activation steering can be a useful method to improve faithfulness in CoT. We extend this line of work by studying how well steering for faithfulness generalizes across cue types, datasets, and methods of constructing the steering vector for three models (Gemma-3 4B, Qwen-3.5 9B, Gemma-3 12B) in a cued question-answering setting. items.title: Smaller, faster, safer: running Kimi and GLM at scale
items.raw_text: Serving frontier models like Kimi and GLM means fighting for GPU memory. Here's how we quantize KV caches, compress model weights, and add integrity checks to serve them faster, cheaper, and safely.
items.reason_zh: Cloudflare分享Kimi和GLM大规模部署的量化与压缩技术，极具工程实践价值。
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare博客介绍了如何大规模服务Kimi和GLM等前沿模型，重点解决GPU内存瓶颈。文章详细阐述了KV缓存量化、模型权重压缩以及完整性检查等技术，以实现更快、更便宜、更安全的推理服务。这些方法对于在资源受限环境下部署大模型具有重要参考意义。
items.title_zh: 更小、更快、更安全：大规模运行Kimi和GLM

items.title: How to Secure AI Agents, MCP Servers, and LLM Apps in Production
items.raw_text:
AI agents, MCP servers, and LLM apps break the core AppSec assumption that applications do what their code says. This guide walks through a practical see-fix-protect framework: a five-layer agentic AI attack surface map, a 12-point misconfiguration checklist, an evidence-based triage matrix, runtime guardrails, and system prompt hardening — plus a maturity self-assessment aligned to NIST AI RMF, OWASP AIMA, ISO/IEC 42001, and the EU AI Act.

The post How to Secure AI Agents, MCP Servers, and LLM Apps in Production appeared first on MarkTechPost.
items.reason_zh: 系统化梳理AI代理安全框架，提供可操作的防护清单，对生产环境部署有重要指导意义。
items.summary_zh: 本文提出AI代理、MCP服务器和LLM应用打破了传统应用安全假设，即应用行为与代码一致。作者介绍了一个实用的“看见-修复-保护”框架，包括五层代理AI攻击面地图、12点错误配置检查清单、基于证据的优先级矩阵、运行时防护措施和系统提示加固策略。此外，还提供了与NIST AI RMF对齐的成熟度自评工具，帮助组织评估自身安全水平。文章强调从攻击者视角审视AI系统，并给出具体实施步骤。
items.title_zh: 如何保护生产环境中的AI代理、MCP服务器和LLM应用

items.title: 拒绝 “黑盒式” 治理：AgentLoop 如何通过语义链路还原，精准发现 AI 调用中的敏感数据泄漏？
items.raw_text: Agent 审计不是风吹草动就告警，而是让真正进入高危队列的风险更准。准不等于少报，也不等于放过不确定风险；准的意思是，单点命中要能回到上下文里被解释，风险事件要能说明它越过了哪条边界、影响了哪些对象、证据在哪里、下一步该怎么处置。
items.reason_zh: 深入探讨Agent审计的语义链路还原，强调可解释性，对AI安全实践有启发。
items.summary_zh: 文章讨论了AgentLoop如何通过语义链路还原来精准发现AI调用中的敏感数据泄漏，拒绝“黑盒式”治理。核心观点是Agent审计不应仅依赖告警，而应让风险事件可解释：单点命中要能回到上下文，风险事件要说明越过的边界、影响对象、证据和处置建议。这种方法提高了风险识别的准确性，有助于安全团队理解攻击路径并采取针对性措施。
items.title_zh: 拒绝“黑盒式”治理：AgentLoop如何通过语义链路还原精准发现AI调用中的敏感数据泄漏？
